title: Wolf Adventures Kashmir
description: A modern ski and snowboard booking platform for Gulmarg, showcasing adventure packages, accommodations, instructors, and streamlined online trip planning.
challenge: Create a premium digital experience that could showcase Gulmarg ski packages while simplifying trip planning through dynamic pricing, online booking, payment deposits, WhatsApp confirmations, and efficient internal booking management.
solution: Built a Next.js and Tailwind platform featuring package and accommodation pages, a custom booking calculator, Razorpay deposit APIs, WhatsApp booking handoff, an internal admin dashboard for bookings and content management, Payload CMS integration, and a Flask-powered itinerary generator for custom PPTX itineraries.
results: Razorpay deposit creation and verification integrated
Admin dashboard for bookings and content management built
Automated itinerary generation with PPTX exports implemented
SEO foundations added, including metadata, sitemap, robots.txt, and structured data
